title: 关联矩阵 A
statement: 电路如图（U_s1 = 10 V，I_s5 = 1 A，R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = R_3 = 4 Ω，R_4 = R_5 = 2 Ω，R_6 = 8 Ω）。画有向图时把 U_s1 与 R_1 的串联看成一条支路（支路 1），把 R_5 与 I_s5 的并联看成一条支路（支路 5），其余每个电阻一条支路；结点编号 1、2、3、4（4 接地），支路编号与方向见下方的有向图。
以结点 4 为参考结点，结点 1、2、3 依次对应 A 的第 1～3 行，支路 1～6 对应第 1～6 列。约定：支路 k **离开**结点 j 时 a_jk = +1，**进入**结点 j 时 a_jk = −1，不相连时为 0。求 A 中的若干元素。

questions.explain: 支路 3 由 2 指向 3，离开结点 2：+1。

questions.ask: a_24 = ?（支路 4 接在结点 2 与参考结点 4 之间）
questions.explain: 支路 4 离开结点 2：+1。它的另一端在参考结点上，参考结点那一行被删去，所以 A 的第 4 列只有一个非零元素。

questions.ask: 完整关联矩阵 A_a（4 行，包括参考结点那一行）的每一列有什么特点？
choices: 恰有一个 +1 和一个 −1，其余为 0
choiceExplain: 一条支路只有两个端点，只能离开一个结点。
支路方向一反，这一列的 +1、−1 就对调。
对：每条支路离开一个结点、进入另一个结点。所以删去参考结点一行后，A 的某列只剩一个非零元素就说明这条支路接在参考结点上，而且 A_a 的各行相加为零——只有 n − 1 行独立。
每列和为 0（+1 与 −1 抵消），不是 1。
questions.explain: 每条支路恰好连接两个结点。

hints: A 的元素只由“支路连在哪两个结点、方向如何”决定，与元件参数无关。
逐列写：先找支路 k 的起点和终点，起点那一行写 +1，终点那一行写 −1。
终点或起点是参考结点 4 时，那一行不在 A 里。
solution: **每列的特点。** 完整的 A_a 每列恰有一个 +1 和一个 −1；删去参考行后，接在参考结点上的支路（1、4、5）只剩一个非零元素。
**检查：** 把 A 的三行相加得 (−1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0)，正是被删去的结点 4 那一行的相反数 ✓。

en.title: The incidence matrix A
statement: The circuit is drawn below (U_s1 = 10 V, I_s5 = 1 A, R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = R_3 = 4 Ω, R_4 = R_5 = 2 Ω, R_6 = 8 Ω). In the graph, U_s1 in series with R_1 counts as one branch (branch 1), R_5 in parallel with I_s5 as one branch (branch 5), and each other resistor as one branch; the nodes are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 (4 is grounded) and the branch numbers and directions are those of the directed graph under the circuit.

Take node 4 as the reference; nodes 1, 2, 3 are rows 1–3 of A and branches 1–6 its columns. Convention: a_jk = +1 if branch k **leaves** node j, −1 if it **enters** node j, 0 if not connected. Find some entries of A.

questions.explain: Branch 1 runs from 4 to 1, so it **enters** node 1: a_11 = −1.
Branch 6 runs from 1 to 3, so it **leaves** node 1: a_16 = +1.
Branch 3 runs from 2 to 3 and leaves node 2: +1.

questions.ask: a_24 = ? (branch 4 joins node 2 and the reference node 4)
questions.explain: Branch 4 leaves node 2: +1. Its other end is the reference node, whose row is deleted, so column 4 of A has a single non-zero entry.

questions.ask: What is special about each column of the full incidence matrix A_a (4 rows, including the reference node)?
choices: it has at least two +1 entries
it does not depend on the branch direction
exactly one +1 and one −1, the rest 0
choiceExplain: A branch has two ends; it leaves exactly one node.
Reversing a branch swaps the +1 and the −1 of its column.

Right: each branch leaves one node and enters another. So after deleting the reference row, a column of A with a single non-zero entry is a branch at the reference node — and the rows of A_a add up to zero, only n − 1 of them independent.
Each column adds up to 0 (+1 and −1 cancel), not 1.
questions.explain: Every branch joins exactly two nodes.

hints: The entries of A depend only on which two nodes each branch joins and in which direction — not on element values.
Work column by column: find where branch k starts and ends; +1 in the start row, −1 in the end row.
If the start or end is the reference node 4, that row is not part of A.
solution: **A column by column** (rows: nodes 1, 2, 3; columns: branches 1–6):
Column 1: branch 1 runs from 4 (reference, deleted) to 1 → only a_11 = **−1**; column 6: from 1 to 3 → a_16 = **+1**, a_36 = **−1**; a_23 = **+1**, a_24 = **+1**.
**Columns.** Every column of the full A_a has exactly one +1 and one −1; after deleting the reference row, the branches at the reference node (1, 4, 5) keep a single non-zero entry.
**Check:** the three rows of A add up to (−1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0), the negative of the deleted row of node 4 ✓.
